reason: Both address corrosion protection and coatings for infrastructure and industrial assets. AZZ is a service provider that applies zinc and coil coatings to customer-owned steel (T:P1.2, T:P2.4, T:P2.7). PPG manufactures and sells paints and coatings across many end markets, including protective coatings for infrastructure, power and marine (C:P1.3, C:P1.13, C:P2.1). The offerings overlap only partly, since PPG sells coating products and AZZ applies coatings as a service. Customers overlap only in industrial and infrastructure markets. PPG also sells to automotive, aerospace, packaging and consumer buyers. The business models differ, and PPG is far broader and global. PPG is closer to a supplier of coatings than a direct competitor.
